sections.title: Movers in Mar Vista, North and South of Venice Boulevard
sections.content: Venice Boulevard splits Mar Vista into two kinds of moves. North of it are single-family streets, among them Beethoven, Meier and Moore, known for mid-century modern houses; south of it, blocks zoned for apartments, with a lot of dingbat buildings. SOS Moving sends two movers and a truck either way and plans the day around the home you're leaving. What to know before you book: Licensed and insured: CPUC licensed, USDOT 3398018, MC 1153871 and CAL-T0192140, with full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Reviewed in public: 4.9 on Google across 1,007 reviews, with the full rating block further down this page. Hourly, stairs included: From $119/hr Monday–Thursday at the cash rate and $135/hr Friday–Sunday. Stairs, long carries and extra stops are part of the hourly rate, not add-on charges. Call 909-443-0004 (Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM) or request a free estimate online.

sections.title: Packing Services for Mar Vista Houses and Apartments
sections.content: Packing up a family house is more than boxing books: a full kitchen, every closet, toys, sports gear and often a garage. Our packing services cover the whole home or only the rooms you'd rather not deal with, so loading can start as soon as the truck arrives. Choose how much help you want: Full pack: The crew packs every room, from kitchen cabinets to garage shelves, before anything goes on the truck. Partial pack: You box the easy things; we take the kitchen, glassware, framed art and anything else that can break. High-value pieces: Art, antiques and design furniture can go with our white glove movers for extra wrapping and careful placement. Tell us which rooms need packing when you call, and we'll build it into your estimate.

sections.title: Moves From Mar Vista to Culver City, Venice and Palms
sections.content: Plenty of Mar Vista moves stay close: a house near Mar Vista Recreation Center traded for a bigger one across the Culver City line, a first apartment in Venice, a rental in Palms. These local moves are billed by the hour, and when the new address is out of the region, our long-distance movers take over. Included at no extra charge: Wrapping and boxes: Moving blankets, shrink wrap, tape and wardrobe boxes for furniture and closets. Furniture and TVs: Beds and tables taken apart and reassembled, wall-mounted TVs taken down, and every piece placed where you want it. Unpacking help: The crew helps you unpack at the new place instead of leaving you with a wall of boxes. Monday–Thursday start at $119/hr at the cash rate, Friday–Sunday are $135/hr, and same-day moves are possible when a crew is free.

sections.title: Long-Distance Moves Out of Mar Vista
sections.content: Moving the family out of state or to the other end of California? We pack, load and drive your household from Mar Vista to the new address, then carry everything into the rooms where it belongs. The road out starts close by: the I-10 forms the neighborhood's northern edge and the I-405 its eastern one. What to expect: Interstate authority: USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871 for moves across state lines, backed by full liability coverage. Packed before pickup: Add packing services and the house is boxed and wrapped before the truck is loaded. Storage between homes: If the new place isn't ready when you leave Mar Vista, storage can hold your things until it is. Staying on the Westside instead? That's a local move, billed by the hour rather than quoted as a long-distance haul.

sections.title: Moving a Business on Venice Boulevard?
sections.content: Shops and offices along Venice Boulevard can book commercial movers from SOS for desks, shelving, files and equipment, taken apart and set back up at the new address. Friday–Sunday dates are available, so the move doesn't have to cut into your business week.

faq.question: What does a Mar Vista house move run per hour?
faq.answer: Two movers and a truck start at $119/hr Monday–Thursday at the cash rate and $135/hr Friday–Sunday, plus a $30 gas fee; the $50 deposit is applied toward your total. Stairs, long carries and extra stops are included, while a piano adds $200 and any item over 300 lbs adds $150. Longer local moves can carry Double Drive Time under CPUC rules, and long-distance moves are quoted separately.

faq.question: Can your truck park on Venice Boulevard?
faq.answer: We don't plan on it. Through much of Mar Vista, Venice Boulevard has a dedicated bus lane and parking-protected bike lanes, so we look for curb space on a side street or use your driveway. Any extra walking distance counts as a long carry, which is already part of the hourly rate.

faq.question: Do you move on Sundays near the Mar Vista Farmers Market?
faq.answer: Yes. We work Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM, and Friday–Sunday moves are $135/hr. On Sundays the farmers market closes part of Grand View Boulevard at Venice Boulevard, so if you live nearby, tell us and we'll plan the truck's route and parking around it.

faq.question: Do you handle apartment moves south of Venice Boulevard?
faq.answer: Yes. That side of Mar Vista is zoned for apartments and has a lot of dingbat buildings, and our apartment movers work them at the same hourly rate. Stairs and the carry from your unit to the truck are included.

faq.question: Can you move us from Mar Vista to Culver City on short notice?
faq.answer: Often, yes: we take same-day moves when a crew is free. Call 909-443-0004 between 8AM and 6PM with both addresses and the size of your home, and we'll check the schedule.
